datasets.name: latest_run
queryLines:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY start_ms DESC) AS rn
  FROM `lindedata`.`ops`.`job_runs`
),
w AS (
  SELECT job_run_id, SUM(rows_written) AS rows_written, COUNT(*) AS commits
  FROM `lindedata`.`ops`.`table_history`
  WHERE job_run_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY job_run_id
)
SELECT
  c.run_id,
  c.start_ts,
  c.end_ts,
  c.result_state,
  c.life_cycle_state,
  c.task_count,
  c.run_page_url,
  c.trigger,
  c.creator_user_name,
  c.state_message,
  ROUND(c.duration_s / 60.0, 1) AS duration_min,
  ROUND(p.duration_s / 60.0, 1) AS prev_duration_min,
  w.rows_written,
  w.commits
FROM r c
  LEFT JOIN r p ON p.rn = 2
  LEFT JOIN w ON w.job_run_id = c.run_id
WHERE c.rn = 1

datasets.name: run_stats
queryLines:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS runs,
  SUM(CASE WHEN result_state = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successful_runs,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN result_state = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS success_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(duration_s) / 60.0, 1) AS avg_duration_min,
  MIN(start_ts) AS first_run_ts,
  MAX(start_ts) AS last_run_ts
FROM `lindedata`.`ops`.`job_runs`
WHERE end_ms > 0

datasets.name: runs
queryLines:
SELECT
  run_id,
  date_format(start_ts, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') AS run_label,
  start_ts,
  end_ts,
  ROUND(duration_s / 60.0, 1) AS duration_min,
  COALESCE(result_state, life_cycle_state) AS result_state,
  trigger,
  task_count,
  run_page_url,
  creator_user_name,
  state_message
FROM `lindedata`.`ops`.`job_runs`
ORDER BY start_ts

datasets.name: task_runs
queryLines:
SELECT
  t.run_id,
  date_format(r.start_ts, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') AS run_label,
  r.start_ts AS run_start_ts,
  t.task_key,
  t.notebook_path,
  t.start_ts,
  t.end_ts,
  ROUND(t.duration_s / 60.0, 2) AS duration_min,
  COALESCE(t.result_state, t.life_cycle_state) AS result_state,
  t.attempt_number,
  t.state_message
FROM `lindedata`.`ops`.`job_task_runs` t
  JOIN `lindedata`.`ops`.`job_runs` r ON r.run_id = t.run_id
ORDER BY r.start_ts, t.start_ts

datasets.name: rows_by_run
queryLines:
SELECT
  r.run_id,
  date_format(r.start_ts, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') AS run_label,
  r.start_ts,
  COALESCE(r.result_state, r.life_cycle_state) AS result_state,
  SUM(h.rows_written) AS rows_written,
  COUNT(h.version) AS commits,
  COUNT(DISTINCT h.table_name) AS tables_written
FROM `lindedata`.`ops`.`job_runs` r
  LEFT JOIN `lindedata`.`ops`.`table_history` h ON h.job_run_id = r.run_id
GROUP BY r.run_id, r.start_ts, r.result_state, r.life_cycle_state
ORDER BY r.start_ts

datasets.name: commits_latest_run
queryLines:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT run_id FROM `lindedata`.`ops`.`job_runs` ORDER BY start_ms DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  h.commit_ts,
  h.task_key,
  h.layer,
  h.table_name,
  h.operation,
  h.version,
  h.rows_written,
  h.files_written,
  ROUND(h.bytes_written / 1048576.0, 2) AS mb_written
FROM `lindedata`.`ops`.`table_history` h
  JOIN latest l ON h.job_run_id = l.run_id
ORDER BY h.commit_ts

datasets.name: history_summary
queryLines:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS commits,
  SUM(CASE WHEN job_run_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unattributed_commits,
  COUNT(DISTINCT table_name) AS tables,
  MAX(commit_ts) AS last_commit_ts
FROM `lindedata`.`ops`.`table_history`

datasets.name: dq_latest
queryLines:
WITH 
ranked AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rule_id ORDER BY run_ts DESC) AS rn
  FROM `lindedata`.`silver`.`dq_rule_results`
)
SELECT
  layer,
  rule_id,
  rule_description,
  action,
  status,
  violations,
  violation_value,
  total_rows,
  ROUND(100.0 * violations / NULLIF(total_rows, 0), 2) AS violation_pct,
  run_ts,
  run_id
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY CASE layer WHEN 'silver' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, rule_id

datasets.name: dq_summary
queryLines:
WITH 
ranked AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rule_id ORDER BY run_ts DESC) AS rn
  FROM `lindedata`.`silver`.`dq_rule_results`
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS rules,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PASS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passed,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'FAIL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'QUARANTINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS quarantined_rules,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('FLAGGED', 'ALERT') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS flagged_rules,
  SUM(CASE WHEN action = 'quarantine' THEN violations ELSE 0 END) AS quarantined_lines,
  SUM(CASE WHEN action IN ('flag', 'alert') THEN violations ELSE 0 END) AS flagged_lines,
  MAX(CASE WHEN layer = 'silver' THEN run_ts END) AS silver_run_ts,
  MAX(CASE WHEN layer = 'gold' THEN run_ts END) AS gold_run_ts
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1

datasets.name: dq_history_info
queryLines:
SELECT
  run_ts,
  run_id,
  layer,
  rule_id,
  action,
  status,
  violations,
  violation_value,
  total_rows,
  ROUND(100.0 * violations / NULLIF(total_rows, 0), 3) AS violation_pct
FROM `lindedata`.`silver`.`dq_rule_results`
WHERE action IN ('quarantine', 'flag', 'alert')
ORDER BY run_ts, rule_id

datasets.name: dq_runs
queryLines:
SELECT
  run_id,
  layer,
  MIN(run_ts) AS run_ts,
  COUNT(*) AS rules,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PASS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passed,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'FAIL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'QUARANTINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS quarantined,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('FLAGGED', 'ALERT') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS flagged_or_alerted,
  SUM(violations) AS violations
FROM `lindedata`.`silver`.`dq_rule_results`
GROUP BY run_id, layer
ORDER BY run_ts DESC

datasets.name: layer_counts
queryLines:
SELECT 1 AS sort_order, 'bronze' AS layer, 'bronze_orders' AS table_name, COUNT(*) AS row_count,
       ROUND(SUM(CAST(ORDER_VALUE AS DECIMAL(18, 2))), 2) AS order_value, SUM(QUANTITY) AS cylinders
FROM `lindedata`.`bronze`.`bronze_orders`
UNION ALL
SELECT 2, 'silver', 'silver_orders', COUNT(*), ROUND(SUM(order_value), 2), SUM(quantity)
FROM `lindedata`.`silver`.`silver_orders`
UNION ALL
SELECT 3, 'silver', 'silver_orders_quarantine', COUNT(*), ROUND(SUM(order_value), 2), SUM(quantity)
FROM `lindedata`.`silver`.`silver_orders_quarantine`
UNION ALL
SELECT 4, 'gold', 'fct_order_line', COUNT(*), ROUND(SUM(order_value), 2), SUM(quantity)
FROM `lindedata`.`gold`.`fct_order_line`
ORDER BY sort_order

datasets.name: reconciliation
queryLines:
WITH b AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CAST(ORDER_VALUE AS DECIMAL(18, 2))) AS v FROM `lindedata`.`bronze`.`bronze_orders`),
     s AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(order_value) AS v FROM `lindedata`.`silver`.`silver_orders`),
     q AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(order_value) AS v FROM `lindedata`.`silver`.`silver_orders_quarantine`),
     g AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(order_value) AS v FROM `lindedata`.`gold`.`fct_order_line`)
SELECT
  b.n AS bronze_rows,
  s.n AS silver_rows,
  q.n AS quarantine_rows,
  g.n AS gold_rows,
  s.n + q.n - b.n AS rows_gap,
  ROUND(COALESCE(s.v, 0) + COALESCE(q.v, 0) - COALESCE(b.v, 0), 2) AS value_gap,
  g.n - s.n AS gold_rows_gap,
  ROUND(COALESCE(g.v, 0) - COALESCE(s.v, 0), 2) AS gold_value_gap,
  ROUND(100.0 * q.n / NULLIF(b.n, 0), 2) AS quarantine_pct
FROM b CROSS JOIN s CROSS JOIN q CROSS JOIN g

datasets.name: quarantine_reasons
queryLines:
SELECT
  _quarantine_reason AS reason,
  COUNT(*) AS row_count,
  ROUND(SUM(order_value), 2) AS order_value,
  MIN(order_date) AS first_order_date,
  MAX(order_date) AS last_order_date,
  MIN(_order_date_raw) AS min_raw_date,
  MAX(_order_date_raw) AS max_raw_date
FROM `lindedata`.`silver`.`silver_orders_quarantine`
GROUP BY _quarantine_reason
ORDER BY row_count DESC

datasets.name: freshness
queryLines:
SELECT 1 AS sort_order, 'bronze' AS layer, 'bronze_orders' AS table_name, 'Last load' AS activity,
       MAX(_loaded_at) AS last_activity_ts,
       to_date(CAST(MAX(ORDER_CREATION_DATE) AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') AS latest_order_date
FROM `lindedata`.`bronze`.`bronze_orders`
UNION ALL
SELECT 2, 'silver', 'silver_orders', 'Last rebuild', MAX(_silver_loaded_at), MAX(order_date)
FROM `lindedata`.`silver`.`silver_orders`
UNION ALL
SELECT 3, 'gold', 'fct_order_line', 'Last rule run',
       (SELECT MAX(run_ts) FROM `lindedata`.`silver`.`dq_rule_results` WHERE layer = 'gold'),
       to_date(CAST(MAX(date_key) AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd')
FROM `lindedata`.`gold`.`fct_order_line`
ORDER BY sort_order

datasets.name: flags_by_year
queryLines:
SELECT
  year(order_date) AS year,
  CAST(year(order_date) AS STRING) AS year_label,
  COUNT(*) AS lines,
  SUM(CASE WHEN is_zero_value THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zero_value_lines,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_zero_value THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS zero_value_pct,
  SUM(CASE WHEN is_negative_value THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS negative_value_lines,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_negative_value THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS negative_value_pct,
  SUM(CASE WHEN order_channel = 'UNKNOWN SOURCE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unknown_channel_lines,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN order_channel = 'UNKNOWN SOURCE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS unknown_channel_pct,
  SUM(CASE WHEN customer_segment = 'Default value for new customers' OR customer_segment IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS placeholder_segment_lines,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN customer_segment = 'Default value for new customers' OR customer_segment IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS placeholder_segment_pct,
  SUM(CASE WHEN is_order_series_3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS legacy_series_lines,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_order_series_3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS legacy_series_pct
FROM `lindedata`.`silver`.`silver_orders`
GROUP BY year(order_date)
ORDER BY year

datasets.name: flags_by_year_long
queryLines:
WITH wide AS (
  SELECT
    year(order_date) AS year,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_zero_value THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS zero_value_pct,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_negative_value THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS negative_value_pct,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN order_channel = 'UNKNOWN SOURCE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS unknown_channel_pct,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN customer_segment = 'Default value for new customers' OR customer_segment IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS placeholder_segment_pct,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_order_series_3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS legacy_series_pct
  FROM `lindedata`.`silver`.`silver_orders`
  GROUP BY year(order_date)
)
SELECT
  CAST(year AS STRING) AS year_label,
  year,
  metric,
  pct
FROM (
  SELECT
    year,
    stack(
      5,
      'Zero value (R04)', zero_value_pct,
      'Negative value (R04)', negative_value_pct,
      'Unknown channel (R06)', unknown_channel_pct,
      'Placeholder segment (R07)', placeholder_segment_pct,
      'Legacy order series', legacy_series_pct
    ) AS (metric, pct)
  FROM wide
)
ORDER BY year, metric

datasets.name: inventory
queryLines:
SELECT
  layer,
  table_name,
  role,
  row_count,
  num_files,
  ROUND(size_bytes / 1048576.0, 2) AS size_mb,
  created_at,
  last_modified,
  snapshot_ts,
  CASE layer WHEN 'bronze' THEN 1 WHEN 'silver' THEN 2 WHEN 'gold' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS layer_order
FROM `lindedata`.`ops`.`table_inventory`
ORDER BY layer_order, table_name

datasets.name: inventory_summary
queryLines:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS tables,
  SUM(row_count) AS total_rows,
  ROUND(SUM(size_bytes) / 1048576.0, 1) AS total_size_mb,
  SUM(num_files) AS total_files,
  MAX(last_modified) AS last_modified,
  MAX(snapshot_ts) AS snapshot_ts
FROM `lindedata`.`ops`.`table_inventory`

datasets.name: comment_coverage
queryLines:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT table_schema, table_name, comment AS table_comment
  FROM `lindedata`.`information_schema`.`tables`
  WHERE table_schema IN ('bronze', 'silver', 'gold', 'ops')
),
c AS (
  SELECT table_schema, table_name, COUNT(*) AS columns,
         SUM(CASE WHEN comment IS NOT NULL AND comment <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS commented_columns
  FROM `lindedata`.`information_schema`.`columns`
  WHERE table_schema IN ('bronze', 'silver', 'gold', 'ops')
  GROUP BY table_schema, table_name
)
SELECT
  t.table_schema AS layer,
  t.table_name,
  CASE WHEN t.table_comment IS NOT NULL AND t.table_comment <> '' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS table_comment,
  c.columns,
  c.commented_columns,
  c.columns - c.commented_columns AS missing_comments,
  ROUND(100.0 * c.commented_columns / NULLIF(c.columns, 0), 1) AS column_comment_pct,
  CASE t.table_schema WHEN 'bronze' THEN 1 WHEN 'silver' THEN 2 WHEN 'gold' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS layer_order
FROM t
  JOIN c ON c.table_schema = t.table_schema AND c.table_name = t.table_name
ORDER BY layer_order, t.table_name

datasets.name: governance_summary
queryLines:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT table_schema, table_name, comment AS table_comment
  FROM `lindedata`.`information_schema`.`tables`
  WHERE table_schema IN ('bronze', 'silver', 'gold', 'ops')
),
c AS (
  SELECT table_schema, table_name, COUNT(*) AS columns,
         SUM(CASE WHEN comment IS NOT NULL AND comment <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS commented_columns
  FROM `lindedata`.`information_schema`.`columns`
  WHERE table_schema IN ('bronze', 'silver', 'gold', 'ops')
  GROUP BY table_schema, table_name
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS tables,
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.table_comment IS NOT NULL AND t.table_comment <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tables_with_comment,
  SUM(c.columns) AS columns,
  SUM(c.commented_columns) AS commented_columns,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(c.commented_columns) / NULLIF(SUM(c.columns), 0), 1) AS column_comment_pct,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN t.table_comment IS NOT NULL AND t.table_comment <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS table_comment_pct
FROM t
  JOIN c ON c.table_schema = t.table_schema AND c.table_name = t.table_name

lines:
## Is the pipeline healthy?

The latest run of the Linde ETL job, the data quality rules it logged, and whether every layer still adds up. Rules, reconciliation, flags, runs and tables each have their own page.

frame.title: Last run duration (min)
frame.description: Latest run of the job. Arrow compares with the run before.

frame.title: Rules failed, latest results
frame.description: Fail-level rules stop the run before anything is published. Anything above zero needs a look.

frame.title: Lines in quarantine
frame.description: Rows held back by a quarantine rule and kept in silver_orders_quarantine. Nothing is deleted.

frame.title: Success rate of recorded runs
frame.description: Finished runs kept by 05_ops_snapshot.

frame.title: Latest result per rule
frame.description: Silver rules from 02_silver, gold rules from 03_gold_star and 04_gold_marts. A rule keeps its last logged result until the next run.

frame.title: Rows gap, bronze vs silver + quarantine
frame.description: Must be zero (R08).

frame.title: Rows gap, gold fact vs silver
frame.description: Must be zero (G02).

frame.title: Freshness per layer
frame.description: Bronze and silver: when they were last loaded. Gold: when its rules last ran.

lines: **How to read.** Every run logs one row per rule in dq_rule_results. Actions: **fail** stops the run before anything is published, **quarantine** moves the rows to silver_orders_quarantine, **flag** keeps the row with a boolean column, **alert** only reports. Silver rules (R01 to R08) run in 02_silver; gold rules (G01 to G07, M01 to M06) run in 03_gold_star and 04_gold_marts.

frame.title: Lines in violation by rule, latest results
frame.description: Zero means the rule passed. Colour is the consequence of a violation.

frame.title: Lines per run: quarantine, flag and alert rules
frame.description: Fail-level rules are not shown: they are zero whenever a run published.

frame.title: Runs logged
frame.description: One row per notebook run and layer.

frame.title: Rule catalogue
frame.description: What each rule checks, with its latest result.

lines:
## Does every layer add up?

Bronze must equal silver plus quarantine in rows and value (R08), and the gold fact must equal silver (G02, G03). Every gap below must be zero.

frame.title: Rows gap, bronze vs silver + quarantine
frame.description: Silver plus quarantine minus bronze (R08).

frame.title: Value gap, bronze vs silver + quarantine
frame.description: Order value, silver plus quarantine minus bronze (R08).

frame.title: Rows gap, gold fact vs silver
frame.description: Fact rows minus silver rows (G02).

frame.title: Value gap, gold fact vs silver
frame.description: Fact value minus silver value (G03).

frame.title: Rows per layer
frame.description: Silver plus quarantine equals bronze; the gold fact equals silver.

frame.title: Order value per layer (EUR)
frame.description: Same reconciliation in value.

frame.title: Quarantine by reason
frame.description: Rows that broke R02 (date) or R03 (quantity). Raw dates are the source integers; a NULL order date means the integer was not a real date.

lines:
## Which lines carry a flag?

Flags keep the line in silver with a boolean column (R04: zero or negative value); alerts only report (R06: channel unknown, R07: placeholder segment). The legacy order series is a flag with no rule. Shares are per order year.

frame.title: Share of lines with a flag or alert, by order year (%)
frame.description: Unknown channel is the one to watch: it is a labelling problem, not customer behaviour.

frame.title: Flagged lines by year
frame.description: Counts and shares of silver_orders lines per order year.

lines:
## How did the job run?

Runs and tasks of the Linde ETL job from the Jobs API, and what each run wrote, from the Delta history of every table. Refreshed by 05_ops_snapshot; runs are kept after the API forgets them.

frame.title: Runs recorded
frame.description: Finished runs kept by 05_ops_snapshot.

frame.title: Average duration (min)
frame.description: End minus start, as the Jobs page shows it.

frame.title: Rows written, latest run
frame.description: Sum of the rows written by every commit of the run. Matches the Jobs page.

frame.title: Commits outside any run
frame.description: Delta commits made while no job task was running: notebooks run by hand, or runs older than the API window.

frame.title: Duration per run (min)
frame.description: Colour is the result of the run.

frame.title: Task duration per run (min)
frame.description: One segment per task, in the order they ran.

frame.title: Rows written per run
frame.description: A run of all four tasks rewrites silver and gold; a run that finds nothing new writes less.

frame.title: Runs
frame.description: Newest last. The run page link opens the Jobs UI.

frame.title: What the latest run wrote
frame.description: Every Delta commit attributed to the latest run, in order.

lines:
## What exists, and is it documented?

Every table the pipeline writes, as of the last snapshot, and the comment coverage read from information_schema. The data dictionary is generated from these comments, so coverage should stay at 100%.

frame.title: Tables tracked
frame.description: Every table the pipeline writes, as of the last snapshot.

frame.title: Rows across all tables
frame.description: Sum of the row counts at snapshot time.

frame.title: Total size (MB)
frame.description: Current version of every table, data files only.

frame.title: Column comment coverage
frame.description: Columns with a comment, from information_schema. Target: 100%.

frame.title: Column comment coverage by table (%)
frame.description: Anything under 100% is a column without a comment.

frame.title: Table inventory
frame.description: From DESCRIBE DETAIL plus a row count, at snapshot time.

frame.title: Comments per table
frame.description: Read from information_schema.tables and information_schema.columns.
